name: cyberriskguardian
description: CyberRiskGuardian Core (Community Edition, free) - scenario-driven cybersecurity risk assessment, steps 1-11 of the 19-step CRG method: context and evidence intake, risk appetite, scenario generation (25-40 candidates, never fewer than 20), screening and selection, validated CRG quantification with CVSS v4.0, and a management summary, with methodology label checks.
